mirror-mind.title: MirrorMind: AI Professional Digital Twin
mirror-mind.shortDescription: An AI-powered digital twin that interacts with recruiters and evaluates job descriptions in real-time.
mirror-mind.impact: Automates initial recruiter screenings with structured knowledge grounding and zero hallucinations.
mirror-mind.description: MirrorMind is an AI-powered professional digital twin that represents me to recruiters, hiring managers, and visitors. It leverages FastAPI and the Groq API on the backend with a premium React frontend. It features an intelligent LLM router to dynamically switch between general conversation and structured Job Description (JD) matching, sliding window memory context, and real-time streaming responses.

hexode-ide.title: Hexode v3.0: AI-Native Collaborative Cloud IDE
hexode-ide.shortDescription: An AI-powered, real-time collaborative cloud IDE built for pair programming, interviews, and modern web development.
hexode-ide.impact: AI-assisted coding, CRDT-based real-time sync, and secure sandboxed execution.
hexode-ide.description: Hexode is a browser-based collaborative IDE designed to bring AI-native development and real-time collaboration directly into the browser. It combines Monaco Editor with CRDT-based synchronization to enable Google Docs-style multi-user editing. The v3.0 release introduces more power to HexodeAI, a context-aware assistant that understands project structure and active files to generate code, debug issues. Hexode also features a standalone online playground for instant coding and interview practice without login or setup, introduced modern and premium themes, distraction free Full Screen mode and more power Shortcuts.

jagjit-kaur-fashion.title: Jagjit Kaur - Heritage Fashion
jagjit-kaur-fashion.shortDescription: A premium e-commerce platform for handcrafted Indian traditional wear.
jagjit-kaur-fashion.impact: Boosted digital presence for a heritage brand with a custom admin dashboard.
jagjit-kaur-fashion.description: Developed a sophisticated e-commerce platform for Jagjit Kaur's heritage fashion collection, featuring handcrafted Indian traditional wear. The application includes a complete admin management system with product upload, analytics dashboard, and admin account management. Implemented real-time Firebase integration for product management, user authentication, and data storage.

collab-hub.title: Coordly
collab-hub.shortDescription: A real-time collaborative platform for remote teams and students to brainstorm, plan, and execute projects together.
collab-hub.impact: Streamlines project workflows with real-time task management, file sharing, and video conferencing.
collab-hub.description: Coordly (formerly CollabHub) is a comprehensive collaboration platform designed to bridge communication gaps for remote teams and students. It combines a dynamic task management system, secure file sharing, and integrated video conferencing into a seamless interface. Built with Next.js, it supports real-time collaboration, ensuring that teams can stay synchronized, organized, and productive whether they're miles apart or in the same room.

drawsync.title: DrawSync
drawsync.shortDescription: A real-time collaborative drawing application built with Next.js.
drawsync.impact: Supports low-latency multi-user drawing synchronization using Liveblocks.
drawsync.description: DrawSync is a feature-rich collaborative drawing application that allows users to create, share, and collaborate on digital drawings in real-time. Implemented with Next.js and Canvas API, it features an infinite canvas with pan and zoom capabilities.

vox-ai.title: VoxAI Assistant
vox-ai.impact: Integrates Google Gemini API for seamless voice-to-text AI interaction.
vox-ai.description: Developed a cutting-edge voice-activated AI assistant web application leveraging advanced speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, and Google's Gemini API for natural language processing.
